title: Bạn có thể giúp tôi kích hoạt SIM được không?
englishTitle: Can you help me activate the SIM?
pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi kich hoat SIM duoc khong
summary: For asking phone staff to help activate a local SIM before you leave the counter.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Best when the SIM is installed but data, calls, or registration still are not working.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep the SIM pack, passport, receipt, and settings screen visible so the helper can see the problem quickly.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi kích hoạt SIM được không?
phrases.english: Can you help me activate the SIM?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi kich hoat SIM duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; giúp tôi means help me; kích hoạt SIM means activate the SIM; được không softens the request.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi kích hoạt SIM được không?
breakdown.english: Can you help me activate the SIM?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi password and SIM-card cards help if activation turns into a connectivity or purchase question.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at SIM shops, airport kiosks, phone stores, hotel desks, or cafes where someone is helping with setup.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Test data before leaving. Open a map or browser while you are still beside the person who can fix it.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Battery, charger, charging, data-top-up, and eSIM cards cover nearby phone problems.
